title: Rhapsody in Blue
writers: George Gershwin (instrumental; orchestrated by Ferde Grofe)

evidence.note: The score was published June 12, 1924 by Harms, Inc.; IMSLP lists the 1924 first publication (the February 1924 premiere was a performance, not publication).
Second source for the publication year.

famous_use: The opening Manhattan montage of Woody Allen's film Manhattan (1979).

listen.performer: George Gershwin with the Paul Whiteman Orchestra
